# SeBA vendoring hook
#
# Upstream: https://github.com/kacper3615/SeBA
#
# To use the official implementation, clone into this directory so that
# `models/models.py` and `trainers/pretrainer.py` are importable:
#
#   git clone https://github.com/kacper3615/SeBA.git third_party/seba
#
# If the official tree is absent, src/models/seba_method.py runs a faithful
# Separated-at-Birth Alignment reimplementation and labels fidelity as
# `faithful_reimplementation`.
